title: Disapointed, not plush at all for $18.11 ! More like a $5.00 thin Walmart towel..
text:
Disapointed, not plush at all for $18.11 ! More like a $5.00 thin Walmart towel... I was expecting a plush towel for $18.11. I'm very disapointed.
When I washed it and put it in the dryer with a dyer sheet it did fluff up a bit , but not much.
The size is a regular towel size.. This is Not the size of a bath sheet , but It should be for the price.

The color is a lavender, not bad.
We live on a river in Ca. And this towel will be used for the kids to use at the river.
